edges.reason: Untrusted msg.sender is written directly into the owner state variable in the Ownable constructor.
The Ownable constructor performs the privileged owner assignment.
onlyOwner compares untrusted msg.sender against the owner state variable.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable for its authorization check.
onlyOwner modifier gates entry into transferOwnership.
newOwner parameter is consumed by transferOwnership.
newOwner (only checked as non-zero) becomes the new owner without further validation.
transferOwnership writes the owner state variable.
onlyTier compares untrusted msg.sender against the tier state variable.
onlyTier reads the tier state variable for its authorization check.
onlyTier modifier gates entry into updateRate.
_tier parameter is consumed by setTier.
setTier writes the tier state variable that controls future privileged calls.
onlyOwner modifier gates entry into setTier.
_oneTokenInWei parameter is consumed by the FlatPricingExt constructor.
Constructor initializes the oneTokenInWei state variable.
newOneTokenInWei parameter is consumed by updateRate.
updateRate overwrites the oneTokenInWei state variable used for pricing.
decimals parameter is used to compute the multiplier local variable.
value parameter flows into calculatePrice computation.
weiRaised parameter is consumed by calculatePrice (unused in flat pricing).
tokensSold parameter is consumed by calculatePrice (unused in flat pricing).
msgSender parameter is consumed by calculatePrice (unused in flat pricing).
Local multiplier is used by calculatePrice to scale the price.
calculatePrice invokes SafeMathLibExt.times on value * multiplier.
calculatePrice performs the division result / oneTokenInWei.
oneTokenInWei is used as the divisor; a zero value would revert or mis-price.
The division result is returned as the token amount from calculatePrice.
SafeMathLibExt.times executes the multiplication a * b.
Operand a flows into the multiplication.
Operand b flows into the multiplication.
Multiplication result is stored in local c before the overflow assert.
Checked value c is returned by times.
SafeMathLibExt.divides executes the division a / b.
Dividend a flows into the division.
Divisor b flows into the division.
Division result is stored in local c.
Checked quotient c is returned by divides.
SafeMathLibExt.minus executes the subtraction a - b.
Operand a flows into the subtraction.
Operand b flows into the subtraction.
Underflow-checked difference a - b is returned by minus.
SafeMathLibExt.plus executes the addition a + b.
Operand a flows into the addition.
Operand b flows into the addition.
Addition result is stored in local c before the overflow assert.
Checked sum c is returned by plus.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is an argument only used inside transferOwnership, so it is folded into that function node.
_tier is an argument only used inside setTier, so it is folded into that function node.

newOneTokenInWei is only used to overwrite the price inside updateRate.
value is a pricing input consumed only by calculatePrice.
weiRaised is a declared argument of calculatePrice and unused for flat pricing.
tokensSold is a declared argument of calculatePrice and unused for flat pricing.
msgSender is a declared argument of calculatePrice and unused for flat pricing.
decimals only feeds the multiplier local inside calculatePrice.
multiplier is a temporary local computed and used only within calculatePrice.
